configuration.concept: Three independent double-track automated tram lines. Compact single cars serve walkable island platforms; end stations reverse via modelled crossovers.

blocks.purpose: Narrow mixed shops and homes around a shared rear passage and small domestic court.
Apartment wings and a few lower homes surround a resident garden with two public-to-court passages.
Small trading fronts and repair premises enclose a paved delivery court, with separate customer and service passages.
